text:
Cheers dispatchers,
The service crew reviewed a concern about handover notes this weekend.

Thank you for keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk steady while the weekend shift moved across teams. I want to note that the handover summary should stay clear, direct, and easy for the welcome team to use when they prepare passengers for boarding. <<FACT F087>> Please keep the language simple, confirm the pet travel details that matter most, and pass along any special care notes without delay so the next agent can support the traveler with confidence.

We also saw a few moments where updates were spread across separate messages instead of one clean note. That made it harder to track the status of each case and left room for small gaps in the handoff. Going forward, please group the key details in one place, use plain wording, and make sure the crew can see what has already been completed before they pick up the file. If a traveler changes plans or adds a companion animal request, send that update through the usual channel right away so no one has to guess at the next step.

Thanks again for the care you put into this work. Aurelia Skyways depends on your attention, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk continues to make a real difference when the notes are complete and the handover is calm. Let's keep building that standard together for the next shift.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
